## Plugin checklist (if you add or change a plugin)
- [ ] `sample()` provided, renders offline
- [ ] English + German via `ctx.t()`
- [ ] `python -m inkyframe.dev check` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] Preview in `docs/img/`

CI attaches rendered previews of all plugins to this PR (Actions → plugin-previews).
